response.overview: A woman begins to experience disturbances from an unseen presence while she is performing her prayers. What initially feels unusual धीरे develops into a terror that unsettles her inner peace. This short film is a spin-off of Pocong The Haunt, featuring the character Leni as the main protagonist, and is set two years before the events of the original film.
response.tagline: Even in prayer, she is not alone.
response.title: Imam
